name: Camping 101: Cooking
summary: At nearby settlements, new adventurers learn to cook and kindle a Basic Campfire for life in the wild. The lesson is offered across Alliance and Horde lands.

sections.title: The Hearth of the Wilderness
sections.body: Every traveler needs to know how to build a fire beyond the safety of fortified walls. A campfire can boil water and roast meat, and it anchors a campsite in unfamiliar country.

sections.title: From Embers to Encampments
sections.body: Apprentice cooks can kindle only modest fires with few surroundings. Greater skill in cooking lets them light larger fires that support more elaborate campsites. Other practical trades also teach ways to make useful furnishings for a camp.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: New adventurers visit a cooking trainer in a nearby settlement to learn basic cooking and light a campfire that anchors an outdoor campsite.

faq.q: Who offers this quest to travelers?
faq.answer: Experienced wilderness guides and adventurers offer this training across both factions, including Eleanor Shackleton, Eric Brighthammer, Lyreena Duskblade, Sam Sarsaparilla, Brakk, Kaga Wildhoof, and Raan Wildwind.

faq.q: Where do Alliance players turn this in?
faq.answer: Alliance adventurers report to trainers in their home territories, such as Tomas in Goldshire, Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos, or Zarrin in Dolanaar.

faq.q: Where do Horde players turn this in?
faq.answer: Horde adventurers can learn with Cook Torka in Razor Hill, William Pickman in Brill, or Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: Can campsite size be expanded later?
faq.answer: Yes. Greater cooking skill teaches you to kindle larger fires that support more camp furnishings in the wild.

faq.q: Can other professions contribute to camping?
faq.answer: Yes. Cooking provides the campfire, while other tradeskill trainers offer ways to craft practical furnishings if you have practiced their crafts.

angles.text: Cooking provides food to restore strength and the campfire at the heart of an outdoor camp.
As an Alliance adventurer leaving Northshire, Dun Morogh, or Teldrassil, you are guided toward towns like Goldshire, Kharanos, and Dolanaar to learn self-reliance before braving the wilds.
As a young Horde fighter in Durotar, Mulgore, or Tirisfal, you are directed toward campfires in Razor Hill, Bloodhoof Village, or Brill.
